_about: Public-domain Austin Phelps (1820-1890), Congregational professor of sacred rhetoric at Andover Seminary, for the Word Hoard: The Still Hour (1860), The Relations of the Bible to the Civilization of the Future (1861), The New Birth (1867), Studies of the Old Testament (1878), The Theory of Preaching (1881), Men and Books (1882), My Portfolio (1882), English Style in Public Discourse (1883) and My Note-Book (1891). His daughter Elizabeth Stuart Phelps has her own shelf. from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 60 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
